title: 美国削减援助资金：200万人失去服务，需求上升谁来补缺口？
speaker: David Miliband

segments.en: So it means that over two million clients have lost services as a result of the reductions in US government funding.
segments.zh: 这意味着超过200万服务对象因美国政府资金削减而失去服务。

segments.en: And so obviously the aid sector is going through
segments.zh: 所以显然，援助行业正在经历

segments.en: where the people who are in most need in the world's crisis zones
segments.zh: 世界上最需要帮助的人，身处危机地区，

segments.en: are just getting less and less to keep them going.
segments.zh: 得到的维持生存的资源越来越少。

segments.en: Is this an ongoing conversation with the US or is this where funding is going to be for the foreseeable future?
segments.zh: 这是与美国持续对话的一部分，还是可预见的未来资金将维持在这个水平？

segments.en: Well, I hope it's ongoing and we're certainly committed to reforming systems, driving up impact,
segments.zh: 嗯，我希望这是持续的，我们当然致力于改革体系、提升影响力，

segments.en: improving cost efficiency. What I always say is that we don't want the demands to be going up, but they are going up.
segments.zh: 提高成本效率。我一直说，我们不希望需求上升，但需求确实在上升。

segments.en: I mean, it's a growth industry for all the wrong reasons.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个因错误原因而增长的行业。
